newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamro buys German disposable product firm.
newsitem.headline: Tamro buys German disposable product firm.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said in a statement on Wednesday its Kolmi-Set unit had acquired German disposable health care products seller Bromeda GmbH for an undisclosed sum.
Tamro said its disposable hospital textiles manufacturer Kolmi-Set was targetting a market share of about 10 percent in Germany in the next few years.
"We have had a marketing vacuum in Central Europe between France and North Europe which this acquisition will fill regarding the strongest country," Tamro said.
Bromeda's sales in the last fiscal period were 7.9 million German marks, and the company has 11 employees, Tamro said.
Kolmi-Set bought Bromeda from Klinikforum GmbH, it said.
Bromeda sells disposable health care products to nearly all hospitals and clinics in Germany, and it will start to market Kolmi-Set's disposable surgical textiles.
Kolmi-Set's 1995 net sales were 252 million markka, up from 219 million in 1994.
Tamro's 1995 net sales were 10.7 billion markka, and its comparable 1994 net sales were 9.6 billion markka.
